decisions.id: W51-4 WINTER_CROP re-derived DEFERRED
decisions.summary: audit/scope.json moves grain.py::WINTER_CROP#winter-crop weights kept -> deferred and dev/claims-deferred.json now lists grain.py::WINTER_CROP (it did not at 3f91becf2)
decisions.why: Measured against FR-010: all five kept hamlets' own execution records (.gencache/<hamlet>/meta.json) list grain.py WinterCropKnob.weights_for and CombMixin._coarse_grain_top_up, which resolves winter_crop by name - a knob in use and a module-level claim on one, so KEPT. The deferral is an artifact: audit/scope.py recognizes a knob only in the form register_knob(Knob(...)), and wave 51 registered this one as register_knob(WinterCropKnob(...)). The effect is that the claim this very wave rewrote reads DEFERRED in make claims-report and escapes the push's claims gate. Fix: teach scope.py the subclassed registration (any register_knob(<Knob subclass>(...))), re-derive, WINTER_CROP back to kept and out of dev/claims-deferred.json, and its re-check by impl-drift recorded on the kept row.

decisions.id: W51-6 the wood shed's standoff recorded on 0043 as the guess the map draws
decisions.summary: 0043's drawing page reworded from 'about 6 ft (a ken) off a wall' to 'a ken beyond the clear strip ... about 9.5 ft from the wall', with the reason that at a ken from the wall 'a farmstead in the largest hamlets would have no way through to the lanes'; WOODSHED_STEP_FT's claim relabeled to that page
decisions.why: This is the spec's named exception path - 'rewording a page to fit the code' (Edge Cases; FR-004; FR-003 excludes a page 'edited for this purpose') - and it was taken without the MODE 1 check the spec requires (spec.md has no new entry since 3f91becf2). On the merits it fails too: the reason is cost, not impossibility - the refusal is the web's reach at a 20-household scaling roll, which is a known, ranked E3 found row (hamletgen/ways/last_resort.py::refuse_unreached#every household reached), and wave 9 already took the spec's legitimate route for exactly this (the step held behind that found row, its claim saying so). The page's figure being a GUESS does not license moving it: the GM's rule is that the implementation moves to the record, and an implementation limit written onto a research page as the guess's reason is the record moved to the code. Fix: restore 0043's 'about 6 ft (a ken) off a wall', restore WOODSHED_STEP_FT's honest held claim (held past the page's ken, behind the found row), and leave the row open behind that E3 row - or fix the web's reach so a ken from the wall seats at 20 and 40 households. The wood shed occasions reviewed PASS at batch 2's close re-open if the standoff moves.

decisions.id: W52-3 the barn privy against the steading annex
decisions.summary: the privy's 'barn' seat set against the kura annex (steading_rects(..., 'N' if kura)[1]); the house's own +x end kept where the farm has no annex
decisions.why: The decision rests on a premise nobody measured - that the steading annex is the barn - and the record says it is not. 0047 puts the privy 'inside the barn' (Suzuki 1959: 'a tub buried in a barn outside the main house') and draws it 'against the barn's outer wall'. The annex is the kura: 0040's drawing page draws 'the storehouse ... as an annex against the house wall', the taxonomy calls farm_sheds 'a farmstead's grain-storehouse kura drawn as an annex', the reader's modal (storage-shed.md) describes 'a farm's fireproof store', and 0040/0028 keep the barn (naya, the free-standing storage shed) a different building - which farm_fixtures.py:81 records the hamlets do not draw at all. So the fix seats a privy against a fireproof storehouse attached to the house and calls it the barn, and on the seven farms in eight with no kura it keeps the very house-end seat the row found drifted - a place that is none of the four 0047 names. The ranking row's fix text names kura_rect, but a row's fix is the audit's estimate, not a ruling, and FR-004 governs. Fix: no barn, no barn seat - where the farmstead draws no barn (every hamlet farm today), the barn place is not offered and the privy takes one of the other three attested places at their weights (0047: 'one of the four places the record names'); or draw the barn the record describes (a new element, its own tier). The north-annex east-gable choice (W52-4) falls with this.
